## Development plan, Expense approvals

**Constraints**

- Target delivery: 2027-04-23 (given)
- Track Workflow: 1 person
- Track Experience: 1 person

5 sub-epics, one per milestone, each holding its work item issues as sub-issues. A box is checked when its issue closes. Conventions, the checkpoint schedule and the comment templates are in [docs/spec/README.md]({{spec_url}}). External items are owned outside the team and tracked outside these issues.

- [ ] {{issue:M1}} Milestone 1, Submit an expense report, due 2027-02-12
  - [ ] {{issue:WI-01}} WI-01 Service scaffold, flag and API contract, by 2027-02-03
  - [ ] {{issue:WI-02}} WI-02 Report form and receipt upload, by 2027-02-10
- [ ] {{issue:M2}} Milestone 2, Route to approvers, due 2027-03-05
  - [ ] {{issue:WI-03}} WI-03 Approval routing engine, by 2027-02-19
  - [ ] {{issue:WI-04}} WI-04 Approver inbox and decisions, by 2027-03-03
- [ ] {{issue:M3}} Milestone 3, Enforce policy, due 2027-03-19
  - [ ] {{issue:WI-06}} WI-06 Approval limits and separation of duties, by 2027-03-08
  - [ ] {{issue:WI-07}} WI-07 Audit log and retention, by 2027-03-17
  - [ ] {{issue:WI-08}} WI-08 Notifications and delegates, by 2027-03-17
- [ ] {{issue:M4}} Milestone 4, Pilot with one team, due 2027-04-09
  - [ ] {{issue:WI-09}} WI-09 Ledger export job, by 2027-04-06
- [ ] {{issue:M5}} Milestone 5, Release, due 2027-04-23
  - [ ] {{issue:WI-11}} WI-11 Release readiness and runbook, by 2027-04-21

### How progress is shown

Each milestone is a sub-epic with its acceptance criteria and demonstration expectations in its body. The demonstration is given by the people who own the items, in a meeting, and its outcome is noted on the sub-epic. Checkpoints between the tracks, each on its date in the plan, are integration checks, not demonstrations, and their short records are comments here. Each work item closes with an evidence comment on its own issue (Demo, Evidence, Decisions, Handoff).
